text.p: Tropical storm warnings are up for the Isle of Youth and the Pinar Del Rio province of West Cuba. Tropical Storm Marco, with 40 mph winds, is centered 130 miles south southeast of Cabo San Antonio on the West tip of Cuba. Marco is nearly stationary. Marco is expected to weaken and dissipate as it drifts westward this period. This is mostly of concern to shipping, however heavy rain may lead to flooding acorss the Isle of Youth and parts of western Cuba.
Tropical Cyclone Cyril will dissipate near New Caledonia during the next 24 hours but may produce heavy rain squalls and local flash floods over the island.

Tropical Cyclone Chantelle, with 74 mph winds, is in the South Indian Ocean near 9s/80e, moving west southwest at 15 mph. This system will continue to intensify and move west southwest over open water, threatening shipping.

Tropical Depression 40W will be fairly weak in the Philippine Sea, only a moderate threat to shipping. This system is near 19.4n/141.3e, moving north at 2 mph. Top winds, now 30 mph, may increase slightly this period.
